summary: 80 ft Aermotor fire tower in Wayne County, Tennessee, administered by the TN Division of Forestry; NHLR-registered 2022. Build date unknown; no staffing history found.

facts.design: 80 ft Aermotor with diagonal internal staircase; original forester's cabin on site

events.note: Registered December 31, 2022 as US 1712, TN 45; nominated by Jason Johns

evidence.supports: administered by Tennessee Division of Forestry
80 ft Aermotor with diagonal internal staircase
evidence.quote: This is an 80ft Aermotor tower with a diagonal internal staircase.
The site also contains the original Forester's cabin.

evidence.supports: cabin similar to Towerview Fire Tower cabin
evidence.quote: located at the Towerview Fire Tower

evidence.supports: list elevation 853 ft and status standing
map name Hardins Creek Fire Tower

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register says Hardin Creek; the Tennessee list and OpenStreetMap say Hardins Creek. The Register and OSM coordinates agree to within a few metres, so one tower is assumed.
The Register gives 851 ft (259 m); the Tennessee list gives 853 ft; OSM gives 258 m. The differences are small, and the Register figure is used.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Register is the only source with design and administration details; it lists the build year as Unknown. The Tennessee list supports the name, the 853 ft elevation and the standing status. OSM supports the name, the 258 m elevation, observation type and lattice construction. Two web searches found no staffing, build or fire history for this tower; the results were about Hardin County and about other towers, and none are used. The Tennessee Division of Forestry Fire Lookout Towers MPS (NRIS 64501237, text at npgallery.nps.gov/NRHP/GetAsset/NRHP/64501237_text) includes a table of extant towers as of March 26, 2014. My reads of it showed only the Hardin County rows before the output cut off, so the Wayne County rows, including Hardins Creek, were not checked. The editor could confirm whether the tower was on that 2014 list. Access and current condition are left out because no source supports them. No photos added. Not verified: whether the forester's cabin still stands.
